_why: R1 had no provenance.json at all, so audit_manuscript.py's [H] check -- the one that tests a
manuscript's claim about its own process -- had never run on this paper. It ran on NM and
found that paper's preregistration sentence to be false. R1's was false in the same way:
'Nothing below reports a criterion whose declaration is not in that record', while the direct
contrasts that REPLACED the withdrawn mediated fraction (m21b) and the reproducibility ceiling's
interval (r1b) are reported in the abstract and in Section 5 and have no frozen declaration.
Both are legitimate -- they are repairs written after the runs they repair, and a repair cannot
be preregistered without preregistering its own conclusion -- but the paper has to say so.
Every artifact either generator reads appears here exactly once, and the audit fails the build
if this file disagrees with what is on disk.

preregistered._rule: a declaration frozen, committed and pushed before the code that produced it existed

survey._rule: establishes design-side facts BEFORE a declaration can be written, and estimates nothing
survey.m33_cluster_census.json: counts what the cluster bootstrap resamples -- targets, design cells and their balance -- so the intervals can be read; no effect is estimated

review._rule: written after the run it checks, because that run needed checking; a review cannot be preregistered without preregistering its own conclusion
review.m17d_typeI_diag.json: the type-I diagnostic that found the permutation null to be too narrow, which is why Prop. 1 exists
review.m18v_verify_repair.json: verifies the repaired randomisation against the joint-covariate permutation it should equal
review.m19_m13c_symmetric_repaired.json: re-runs Cut 2 under the repaired null
review.m19_m13d_stability_repaired.json: re-runs the free-energy caliper sweep under the repaired null
review.m19_m15_structure_filter_repaired.json: re-runs the corpus authors' structure filter under the repaired null
review.m21b_direct_contrast.json: the direct contrasts that REPLACE M21's withdrawn retention figure, written after m26r3 showed the retention estimator uninformative here; reported in the abstract
review.m21v_verify.json: recomputes M21's arm with an independently written estimator
review.m26r2_positive_control.json: the first calibration attempt, kept because its failure mode has a name
review.m26r3_realistic_calibration.json: recalibrates retention at the arm separation this corpus actually has
review.m26r4_calibration_symmetry.json: re-reads m26r3's sweep after the audit found one arm's correlation reported and the other's omitted inside the same withdrawal
review.m28r_review.json: reviews M28's two boundary results before either is written down
review.m29r_review.json: reviews the cross-domain arm's bin sweep before its bound is read
review.r1b_ceiling_interval.json: puts an interval on the reproducibility ceiling, a debt recorded in an earlier review and never paid; written after the ceiling was already in use
review.m61c_error_by_type.json: asks whether the outcome's measurement error differs by pair type, a question M61 left open; stakes nothing

support._rule: a supporting or display quantity for a claim already made elsewhere; states no new claim
support.m23c_imbalance_bound.json: the within-caliper residual imbalance behind Eq. (7), which Prop. 1's part (ii) needs and which states no new claim

corpus._rule: released or derived DATA the analysis reads. Not a run: it states no claim, estimates nothing, and there is nothing for it to have declared.
corpus.panel_f1_fresh.json: population 'sample 2 (main)': the designs, their scores and the shipped predictor panel
